name: Magellan's
description: The most prestigious and elegant restaurant at Tokyo DisneySea — Magellan's is a stunning full-service restaurant themed to the age of exploration with elaborate antique navigation instruments, warm candlelit atmosphere and an outstanding menu of European-inspired cuisine. Booking is essential and widely considered the finest dining experience at any Disney park in Asia.

name: Sailing Day Buffet
description: A vibrant and popular buffet restaurant aboard a beautifully themed sailing vessel in Mediterranean Harbour — serving a wide range of Japanese and international dishes including fresh seafood, Japanese classics, pasta and roast meats. One of the most atmospheric and enjoyable dining experiences at Tokyo DisneySea.

name: Vulcania Restaurant
description: A dramatic quick-service restaurant inside the volcanic landscape of Mysterious Island — Vulcania serves Japanese and Western quick-service meals in an extraordinary subterranean environment inspired by the fictional Vulcania island of Captain Nemo. The most atmospherically unique dining experience at Tokyo DisneySea.

name: Casbah Food Court
description: A lively and colourful North African themed food court in the Arabian Coast zone — Casbah serves a range of Middle Eastern and Japanese-inspired dishes in an elaborately themed marketplace environment. The most vibrant and exotic dining atmosphere at Tokyo DisneySea.
